blocks.title: Launch token
blocks.blurb: Standard IMD token: 1B supply, no owner.
blocks.sentence: Token: {name} ({symbol}), the standard launch token: 1,000,000,000 supply, 18 decimals, plain transfers, no owner functions.

blocks.title: Bring your own token
blocks.blurb: Your name, symbol, supply and decimals.
blocks.sentence: Token: my own token {name} ({symbol}), supply {supply:n}, {dec} decimals, minted once to the launch factory, no transfer fee, nothing minted after launch, no privileged address can move, freeze, pause or seize a holder’s tokens.

blocks.title: Swap fee
blocks.blurb: A fixed cut of every swap, sent somewhere.
blocks.sentence: Take {rate:1}% of the ETH side of every {applies} as a hook fee, settled in ETH inside the swap that paid it (mint a claim when the PoolManager cannot pay it directly), and send it to {to}. Expose claimFees() that anyone may call to redeem claims to the recipient.

anyone.label: Send collected fees to the recipient

blocks.who: Runs itself; fees reach the recipient automatically.

blocks.title: Fee that fades
blocks.blurb: Starts high at launch, settles to a floor.
blocks.sentence: The hook fee starts at {start:1}% of the ETH side of every swap when the pool opens and decreases linearly to {end:1}% over the first {mins} minutes, then stays at {end:1}%. Expose currentFeeBps() as a view.

blocks.title: Different buy and sell fees
blocks.blurb: One rate for buys, another for sells.
blocks.sentence: Take {buy:1}% of the ETH side of every buy and {sell:1}% of the ETH side of every sell as a hook fee, settled in ETH inside the swap that paid it (mint a claim when the PoolManager cannot pay it directly), and send it to {to}. Expose claimFees() that anyone may call to redeem claims to the recipient.

anyone.label: Send collected fees to the recipient

blocks.title: Whale fee
blocks.blurb: Big swaps pay an extra fee.
blocks.sentence: Any swap whose ETH side is larger than {above} ETH pays an extra {extra:1}% of its ETH side as a hook fee, on top of any other hook fee, settled the same way and sent to the same recipient.

blocks.title: Volatility fee
blocks.blurb: Fee rises when the price moves fast.
blocks.sentence: When the pool price has moved more than {move:1}% within the last {blocks} blocks, the hook fee on the ETH side of every swap is {fee:1}% until the move settles below that; otherwise the normal hook fee applies. Expose isVolatile() as a view.

view.label: Whether the raised fee applies now

blocks.title: Split the fee
blocks.blurb: Send the hook fee to two places.
blocks.sentence: Split every hook fee: {a}% to my wallet and {a:rest}% to {b}.

blocks.title: Dynamic LP fee
blocks.blurb: The pool’s own fee tier moves with volatility. Own pools only.
blocks.sentence: The pool uses a dynamic LP fee that the hook sets per swap between {lo}% and {hi}% based on recent price volatility (the BaseDynamicFee pattern). Expose currentLpFee() as a view.
blocks.who: Runs itself; sets the pool fee each swap.

blocks.title: Anti-sniper window
blocks.blurb: Cap what one wallet can buy right after launch.
blocks.sentence: For the first {mins} minutes after the pool opens, each wallet may buy at most {pct:1}% of the total supply in total; larger buys revert. Expose windowEndsAt() as a view.
blocks.risk: Per-wallet limits can be sidestepped by splitting across several wallets.
blocks.who: Runs itself for the window, then switches off.

blocks.title: Max buy per wallet
blocks.blurb: A permanent cap on what one wallet can buy.
blocks.short: max {pct:1}% of supply per wallet, ever
blocks.sentence: Each wallet may buy at most {pct:1}% of the total supply through this pool in total, for the life of the pool; larger buys revert. Sells are never blocked. Expose boughtBy(address) as a view.

view.label: How much a wallet has bought

blocks.risk: Per-wallet limits can be sidestepped by splitting across several wallets.

blocks.title: Max swap size
blocks.blurb: Reject any single swap above a size.
blocks.sentence: Reject any single swap whose specified amount is above {tokens:n} {@symbol}, in either direction. This caps only the amount the swapper specifies.
blocks.risk: A trader can split one large trade into several smaller ones.

blocks.title: Anti-sandwich
blocks.blurb: Stop sandwich attacks within a block.
blocks.sentence: Protect swappers from sandwich attacks: within one block, swaps against the direction of the block’s first swap execute at no better than the block’s opening price (the AntiSandwichHook pattern).

blocks.title: Cooldown
blocks.blurb: Make a wallet wait between swaps.
blocks.sentence: A wallet must wait at least {secs} seconds between its swaps in this pool. Expose nextSwapAt(address) as a view.

view.label: When a wallet may swap again

blocks.risk: Per-wallet limits can be sidestepped by splitting across several wallets.

blocks.title: Circuit breaker
blocks.blurb: Pause trading briefly after a violent move.
blocks.sentence: If the pool price moves more than {move}% within {blocks} blocks, reject every swap for the next {pause} minutes, then resume automatically. Liquidity can still be removed during the pause. Expose haltedUntil() as a view.
blocks.risk: A large trader can trip the breaker on purpose to stall trading for everyone.

blocks.title: Buyback jar
blocks.blurb: Collect a cut, then buy your token with it.

params.label: Then
options: send them to the treasury address

blocks.short: {rate:1}% into a jar, buy back at {trig} ETH, {act:act}
blocks.sentence: Collect {rate:1}% of the ETH side of every swap into a jar held by the hook. Whenever the jar holds at least {trig} ETH, anyone may call buyback() to buy {@symbol} from this pool with the whole jar and {act}. The swap that fills the jar does not revert if the buyback fails. Expose buyback() that anyone may call and jar() as a view.

anyone.label: Spend the jar when it is full

blocks.who: Runs itself; anyone presses the button when the jar is full.

blocks.title: Share fees with LPs
blocks.blurb: Part of the hook fee goes back to liquidity providers.
blocks.short: {pct}% of the hook fee to LPs
blocks.sentence: Donate {pct}% of every hook fee back to the pool’s liquidity providers in proportion to their liquidity (through the PoolManager’s donate), and send the rest as the fee block says.

blocks.title: Liquidity lock
blocks.blurb: Liquidity cannot be removed for a while.
blocks.sentence: Liquidity added to the pool is locked for {days} days from the time it was added; removing it earlier reverts. The launch factory’s own zero-change fee collection is always allowed. Expose unlockAt(address) as a view.

blocks.title: JIT penalty
blocks.blurb: Punish liquidity that only shows up for one trade.
blocks.sentence: Penalize just-in-time liquidity: liquidity removed within {blocks} blocks of being added forfeits the fees it earned in that time to the remaining liquidity providers (the LiquidityPenaltyHook pattern).

blocks.title: LP allowlist
blocks.blurb: Only listed wallets may add liquidity.
blocks.ownerPower: add and remove liquidity-provider allowlist addresses
blocks.sentence: Only addresses the owner has added to a liquidity allowlist may add liquidity; anyone may remove their own. The launch factory’s initial seeding is always allowed. Expose setLpAllowed(address[] accounts, bool allowed) for the owner and isLpAllowed(address) as a view.

view.label: Is a wallet on the list

blocks.who: You (the owner) keep the list up to date.

blocks.title: Minimum position
blocks.blurb: No dust positions.
blocks.sentence: Reject adding liquidity worth less than {eth} ETH at the current price. Removing is never blocked by this rule.

blocks.title: Scheduled open
blocks.blurb: No trading before a date and time.
blocks.sentence: Reject every swap before {when} UTC. Liquidity may be added before then. Expose opensAt() as a view.

blocks.title: Trading hours
blocks.blurb: Only trade during certain hours.
blocks.sentence: Allow swaps only between {from}:00 and {to}:00 UTC each day, judged by block timestamp; reject all others. Liquidity changes are always allowed. Expose isOpen() as a view.

blocks.title: Allowlist opening
blocks.blurb: Only listed wallets may buy at first.
blocks.ownerPower: add and remove buyer allowlist addresses
blocks.sentence: For the first {mins} minutes after the pool opens, only addresses the owner has added to an allowlist may buy. After that, anyone. Expose setAllowed(address[] accounts, bool allowed) for the owner and isAllowed(address) as a view.

view.label: Is a wallet on the list

blocks.who: You (the owner) keep the list up to date.

blocks.title: Pause switch
blocks.blurb: The owner can pause swaps. Buyers may dislike it.
blocks.sentence: The owner may pause and unpause swaps. Liquidity can always be removed while paused. Expose pause() and unpause() for the owner and paused() as a view.

blocks.title: Sunset
blocks.blurb: The hook stops enforcing rules after a date.
blocks.sentence: After {when} UTC every rule above stops applying and the hook lets every swap and liquidity change through unchanged, forever. Expose sunsetAt() as a view.

blocks.title: Price oracle
blocks.blurb: Other contracts can read a time-weighted price.
blocks.sentence: Record a time-weighted average price of the pool that other contracts can read (the BaseOracleHook pattern, with a Uniswap v3 compatible observe interface). Expose twap(uint32 secondsAgo) as a view returning the average price as a Q64.96 sqrt price.

view.label: The average price over a period

blocks.who: For other contracts and apps: they read the price. Nothing for you to do.

blocks.title: Limit orders
blocks.blurb: Users can place orders that fill at a price.
blocks.sentence: Let users place limit orders in the hook that fill automatically when the pool price crosses the order price, and withdraw unfilled orders at any time (the LimitOrderHook pattern). Expose placeOrder(bool zeroForOne, int24 tick, uint256 amount) returning an id, cancelOrder(uint256 id) and claim(uint256 id).

user.sig: placeOrder(bool zeroForOne, int24 tick, uint256 amount)
user.label: Place an order

blocks.who: For traders: they get an order form on your hook page.

blocks.title: Yield on idle liquidity
blocks.blurb: Idle liquidity is lent out to earn yield.
blocks.sentence: Liquidity the pool is not using at the current price is lent on {proto} and recalled when needed for swaps (the ReHypothecationHook pattern). If {proto} has no deployment on the chosen chain, the swarm must report that as a blocker instead of substituting another protocol. Expose rebalance() that anyone may call.

anyone.label: Move idle liquidity in or out of lending

blocks.who: Runs itself; anyone can press rebalance.

blocks.title: Batch auctions
blocks.blurb: Swaps settle together in batches.
blocks.sentence: Swaps are not filled immediately: the hook collects them and settles each batch at one clearing price every {secs} seconds (the BaseAsyncSwap pattern). Expose settleBatch() that anyone may call once a batch period has ended.
blocks.who: Runs itself; anyone can settle a finished batch.

blocks.title: Stable curve
blocks.blurb: Constant-sum pricing for like-valued assets.
blocks.sentence: Replace the pool’s pricing with a constant-sum curve suited to two assets of the same value (the BaseCustomCurve pattern).

blocks.title: Pool rules
blocks.blurb: Which pools may use this hook.
blocks.sentence: Only pools where one currency is native ETH and the fee tier is {tier}% may be initialized with this hook; any other pool initialization reverts.

blocks.title: Donation rules
blocks.blurb: Who may donate to the pool.
blocks.sentence: Donations to the pool are allowed from {who}; all other donations revert. Expose setDonor(address account, bool allowed) for the owner.
blocks.who: You (the owner) decide who may donate.

blocks.title: Prize pot
blocks.blurb: A cut of buys goes to a lucky buyer.
blocks.short: {rate:1}% of buys to a pot, drawn every {hours}h
blocks.sentence: Collect {rate:1}% of the ETH side of every buy into a prize pot. Every {hours} hour(s), anyone may call draw() to pay the whole pot to one buyer from that period chosen at random, weighted by how much ETH each buyer spent; randomness comes from recent block data, which is acceptable for small pots and must be stated in the README. Expose draw() that anyone may call, and pot() and nextDrawAt() as views.

anyone.label: Run the draw when the period is over

blocks.risk: The draw uses block data for randomness. A well-funded player can tilt the odds. Keep pots small and say so on your token’s page.
blocks.who: Runs itself; anyone presses the button when the period ends.

blocks.title: Custom rule
blocks.blurb: One rule in your own words.
blocks.sentence: {text:clean}
blocks.who: Whatever your sentence says. Your launch’s own audit covers it.
